title: Filter countries by minimum name length
description: Write a function `filter_min_length(countries, n)` that returns the countries whose name has at least `n` characters, using `filter()`.
hints: Function to consider: filter(), combined with len()
len(c) >= n is the per-item condition here - a single comparison operator (>= instead of ==) is the only difference from filter_exact_length.
Return list(filter(lambda c: len(c) >= n, countries)).
expected_behavior: Returns the countries whose name has n or more characters.
solution:
def filter_min_length(countries, n):
    return list(filter(lambda c: len(c) >= n, countries))
explanation: With a 6-country list where the shortest names are 6 letters long, 'six letters or more' happens to match everyone - a good reminder to check the actual data rather than assume a filter narrows the results.
